title: Shared metrics must go through enrichSharedMetric to merge link metadata
answers: How are shared metrics converted to inline experiment metrics?
Where do shared metric breakdowns and breakdown attribution get merged?
Fixing shared metric breakdown bug in experiment results
body:
Saved/shared metrics on an experiment (`experiment.saved_metrics`) are reshaped into the inline `ExperimentMetric` shape only via `enrichSharedMetric` in `frontend/src/scenes/experiments/utils.ts`.
It sets name, `sharedMetricId`, `isSharedMetric: true`, and merges per-experiment link metadata: `breakdownAttributionType/Value` (only when type is defined), `breakdownFilter.breakdowns` (defaults to []), and `breakdown_limit` (only when defined).
Both `getOrderedMetricsWithResults` and `metricResults` call it after filtering by `metadata?.type === metricType`.
Any new consumer of saved_metrics should reuse it rather than inlining a copy, otherwise fixes diverge. Changes to metadata merging belong in this one function; `utils.test.ts` covers both callers.
applies: frontend/src/scenes/experiments/utils.ts shared/saved metric handling in experiments
